attr.title: FTL: Faster Than Light
attr.desc: Command a spaceship and its crew on a run across a galaxy at war: manage power, crew and weapons in real-time combat you can pause at any moment, and make it to the Federation fleet before the Rebels catch you. Gamepad and touch support is provided by FTLHELM, a custom control layer. See the in-game help for controls.
attr.inst: Requires the Linux version of the game from Steam or GOG. Steam: to get it on any OS, open steam://open/console in a browser and enter: download_depot 212680 221002. When Steam prints "Depot download complete", copy the contents of the data folder in Steam/steamapps/content/app_212680/depot_221002/ into ports/ftl/gamedata/. GOG: copy the Linux installer (ftl_advanced_edition_*.sh) into ports/ftl/gamedata/; the port unpacks it at the first launch. On devices with 1 GB of RAM, turn on swap or zram in the system settings.
